description: Medicare Part-B provider utilization — HCPCS services rendered, beneficiaries served, and submitted / Medicare-allowed / Medicare-paid amounts (CMS 'Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners — by Provider and Service', keyless; data.cms.gov data-API). Input: `npi` (10-digit) OR `state` (2-letter) — at least ONE is REQUIRED (the table is 9.78M rows; an all-empty query is refused; providerType/hcpcsCode alone are NOT enough to scope). Optional `providerType` (exact CMS specialty, e.g. 'Family Practice'), `hcpcsCode` (e.g. '97110'), `size` (1–100, def 25), `offset`. Returns { services:[{ npi, providerName, credentials, providerType, city, state, zip, hcpcsCode, hcpcsDescription, totalBeneficiaries, totalServices, avgSubmittedCharge, avgMedicareAllowed, avgMedicarePayment }] } + honest _meta. ★HONESTY: totalAvailable is the EXACT count from a SEPARATE stats sub-query (…/data-viewer/stats → found_rows); if that count fails, totalAvailable is null + a disclosing note (never length-faked). hasMore = offset+returned < total. Aggregate/payment values: numeric-string → number|null (genuine 0 stays 0, absent → null, never 0-faked); NPI/HCPCS/names are null-never-empty-string. Genuine no-match → honest empty; 4xx → invalid_input/not_found; 5xx → THROWS; 200 non-array/non-JSON → schema_drift. PUBLIC PROVIDER-LEVEL AGGREGATE figures (no patient identifiers) for ONE annual vintage (dataset year disclosed in _meta) — utilization snapshot, NOT a fraud/quality/fitness determination.

hcpcsCode.description: An optional HCPCS/CPT service code filter (→ HCPCS_Cd), e.g. '97110', 'G0463'. Validated ^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,10}$.

npi.description: A 10-digit National Provider Identifier (→ Rndrng_NPI), e.g. '1003000126'. Provide at least this OR `state`. Validated ^\d{10}$.

offset.description: Row offset for pagination (default 0). Page with _meta.pagination.nextOffset.

providerType.description: An optional specialty filter matching the CMS provider type EXACTLY (→ Rndrng_Prvdr_Type), e.g. 'Family Practice', 'Physical Therapist in Private Practice'. Allowed: letters/digits/space/& . , ( ) / ' - (≤100 chars).

size.description: Max provider-service rows to return (1–100, default 25). Offset-paginated.

state.description: A 2-letter US state/territory code (→ Rndrng_Prvdr_State_Abrvtn), e.g. 'VA', 'CA'. Provide at least this OR `npi`. Validated ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

name: cms_medicare_provider_services
